text:
laura: Heads up - opening a tiny docs PR to annotate Optimize toolkit snippets. Changes: rename kv-prefetch -> kv_cache, add a short language matrix (py/js/go), and note a quant-profile caveat for short-sequence workloads. PR soon: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1620
chris: LGTM. can you add a one-line table showing behavior parity across py/js/go? we had a mismatch in the Go snippet last week.
maya: also call out the perf regression we saw with the short-seq quant profile (link to eval). that'll reduce support churn.
kevin: update any Console links pointing to /optimize/guide -> those moved and caused 404s in the sample app.
laura: will include a 3-row language matrix and the quant caveat, plus a linkcheck step in the PR description.
laura: Go snippet i'll add:
```go
// Go client: enable KV cache (was kv-prefetch)
client := redwood.NewClient(opts)
client.Optimize().SetKVCache(true)
resp, err := client.Generate(ctx, req)
```
chris: for JS example, show streaming + batching together so folks see interplay: `stream: true` + `batchSize: 8`.
laura: keeping examples <40 lines. samir, you good to review?
docs-bot: label added: docs/optkit, status: needs-review
samir: happy to review, i'll focus on clarity and links :eyes:
laura: pushing branch and adding language matrix + quant note. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1620
chris: small nit: clarify default behavior for `kv_cache` when disabled (falls back to runtime prefix caching).
laura: added sentence and a short fallback snippet.
maya: add a one-line migration tip for teams with custom batching logic: verify microbatch boundaries after rename.
laura: added under "migration notes" and pushed final patch.
samir: reviewing now; will leave inline comments if needed. :thumbsup:
laura: thanks all - will merge after one approval and run docs link-check job. ping here if you spot a stray path and i'll patch in this PR.
kevin: if we change console anchors, open redirect ticket with infra so external links don't break. added to PR checklist.
laura: added infra-redirects checklist. merging on green :party:
